title: Soho St noise/trees
gallery_text: Two inventories of SoHo-centered streets record different kinds of urban experience: where living street trees were counted in 2015–2016 and where people filed commercial, street, or vehicle noise reports in 2025. Placing them in the same grid asks where reported disturbances and street greenery overlap, and where government data leaves the experience of a street harder to describe.
description:
I chose SoHo because I am always in that area and wanted to examine something I experience in everyday life: the relationship between street greenery and reported noise. The map focuses on a SoHo-centered study window, including some adjacent streets, divided into equal-sized grid cells to compare the two datasets. I used google co lab, open ai to facilitate some codings and photoshop.
